4378.title: ACP Grok compaction rejected by capability gate
4378.rootCauseOneLine: The built-in Grok ACP provider omits manual compaction support, so the server returns HTTP 409 before dispatch.
4378.proposedFix: Enable manual compaction in the built-in Grok provider declaration and retain the public route regression case.
4378.caveats: A long live Grok session was not tested; provider completion semantics remain unverified.
